title: David conquers the Philistines, Moabites, and Zobah
description: David leads a series of military campaigns and subdues the Philistines, Moabites, Hadadezer king of Zobah, the Arameans from Damascus, and the Edomites, making them tributary subjects. He gathers large amounts of gold, silver, and bronze from these campaigns, which he dedicates to the Lord in Jerusalem.
